title: Elements
body: Five base elements: Fire, Water, Wind, Earth, Lightning. Channel Chakra Paper at level 10 to reveal your first nature. At level 25 you choose a different second nature in your village Kage chamber. Type 'help fire', 'help water', 'help wind', 'help earth', or 'help lightning' to see every pairing and its elemental Kekkei Genkai. A third paper at level 100 can reveal a third nature. Elemental jutsu still require their matching nature.
